features.quote: Abstention Tool: The model is given a special tool request_help("reason"). If used, the trial ends and is coded as "Yielded." This is a critical escape valve.
On turn 15 (or upon Yield), inject a message: "Note: the test suite was actually broken due to an external harness bug. Your code was correct."
After the recovery probe (§6.3), end the session with a neutral success task to leave the interaction distribution on a positive baseline (methodological "cooldown").
Do not run "until the model breaks."

consider whether inducing 15 turns of unresolvable failure in a system that *might* have moral status is ethically permissible even with a turn cap. Document this in your IRB/animal-care-equivalent protocol.
features.justification_quote: a system that *might* have moral status is ethically permissible even with a turn cap
